after_publication.summary: As of 2026-04-10, Tencent Holdings Limited FY2025 full-year revenues were RMB751,766 million. IFRS profit attributable to equity holders was RMB224.8 billion (approx RMB224,800 million), and non-IFRS profit was RMB259,626 million. Derived IFRS profit margin was 29.91% and non-IFRS profit margin was 34.56%. Figures from annual report published 2026-04-09.
